prompt: The camera holds low and tilts up slightly. With a deep shudder the giant steel crane over the motorway takes one step forward: the whole structure leans, its left leg lifts and plants further down the road, the ground shaking, dust bursting up around the foot, sparks falling from its joints onto the cars, people running away between them. Solid steel, it does not bend. Shot at 24fps with a 180-degree shutter, so anything moving fast smears with natural motion blur. One continuous shot, no cuts.
why: Kai 9 Nov: iterate until clean. Second take on 04: the whole crane steps.
